question: GQ-006
survey: every database under ~/foundry-data checked for a vault backup
prioritised_by: which databases claims and metrics actually cite, not by size

agent_memory_store.why: This is the exact number that disproved the GQ-005 category-momentum claim (which asserted 929). The evidence behind an active dispute now has a backup.

timeout_lesson: A five-table count(*) sweep over the 1.88 GB vault copy timed out at 10 minutes — the same failure as the passage index. Verification on the vault must use bounded queries; whole-table counts are only affordable for the 1.09 GB graph.
false_positive_caught: My survey initially reported people.sqlite as BACKED-UP. It is not — the glob matched people_v2* by prefix. Prefix matching produced a confidently wrong answer, which is the same wrong-key pattern recorded in CHARTER.md.
